verdict.rationale: Basecamp's pricing page lists a first-party capability to "Track hours/time spent working on projects," so time logging against projects is directly claimed. It is a single thin line, though, with no detail on how entries are made. Nothing shows time can be logged against individual to-dos or tasks. Missing for 10: task-level time logging, documentation of how time entries are created or reported, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can log time directly against tasks and projects

citations.quote: Track hours/time spent working on projects.
